qa.q: Rory, do you like going to the countryside?

qa.a: Just enough to stop myself from being burned out by the city life I currently have. I think when I go back I'll be doing it more often, though, since I want to reconnect with nature and the people in my life. And the countryside seems to be the ideal place to do that.
